These are noncurrent compensated absences. The rules use accrued liabilities only for amounts due soon, so debt - due in more than one year or the Compensated Absences category would fit better.
The line mixes sale of property with insurance proceeds (reimbursements). The rules ask for a review note naming the mix, and none is present (same for detail[8]).
